newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 4,136 to dollar for Jan 6-7 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 4,136 to dollar for Jan 6-7 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 4,136 to the dollar for January 6 and 7, 1997.
This reference rate was set on Tuesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Monday for December 27 to January 5 is 4,035 to the dollar. It was 3,914 for December 24 to 26. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
